$comment: Device kinds and device entries (bipe ADR 0291, bipe-chat/bipe#1479). Every device of an account has a kind. A Bipe client, bipe-mcp and the Beeper bridge each write their own device entry: an m.room.message with msgtype `msgtype` and the field `field`, end-to-end encrypted in the account's drafts room (registries/drafts.json, docs/drafts-room.md), with source "self". The phone that approves a new device may write an entry for it with source "approval", from the user agent on the consent screen (userAgents, browsers, systems). A self entry beats an approval entry; the newest of each wins. Text fields are at most fieldMaxLength characters. `section`: devices (Aparelhos) or programs (Assistentes e programas). `icon`: a Phosphor icon in bipe-app tools/phosphor.json. `leavesBrazil`: the row says fora do Brasil. unknownWarning: false until every Bipe writer ships (#1481 to #1485), so a Bipe device that has no entry yet is not flagged; while false, a device with no entry shows kind unknown with no warning. Rules: deviceInfoFromEvent, userAgentInfo, deviceRows in tools/lib/registries.mjs; test-vectors/device-kinds.json.
